_comment: Which source-book sections have become lessons. `sources` declares reading order — filename sort is not reading order. `claims` records slicing decisions already made, so they are never silently re-proposed. `heading` must match the transcribed markdown heading exactly. Reconciled by scripts/coverage.mjs.
_source_of_record: source-content/nahw-full-book.pdf (415 pages, all four volumes, الدروس النحوية). Transcribed in <=30 page chunks by scripts/transcribe-book.mjs, then corrected by scripts/lint-transcription.mjs. Volume boundaries in PDF pages: vol1 7-76, vol2 77-164, vol3 165-272, vol4 273-414; each volume's own فهرس sits at its end. Full per-page map in source-content/page-map.json. PDF page number equals the book's printed page number.
_superseded: source-content/nahw-book-13-25.superseded.md is a different edition with different headings and only partial tashkeel. Lessons 1-4 were authored from it, but the claims below are remapped onto the PDF edition so future slicing works against one consistent text. Do not use the superseded file as source.

sources.note: الكتاب الأول, from the start of teaching content.

claims.heading: تَكَوُّنُ الْكَلِمَاتِ
claims.note: Folded into lesson 1's introduction. The word-length trivia was cut — see omitted_content.yaml.

claims.heading: أَقْسَامُ الْاسْمِ
claims.note: Container heading only; its two numbered subsections became lessons 3 and 4.

claims.heading: أَقْسَامُ الْجَمْعِ
claims.note: Merged into lesson 4 as concepts 3-5 rather than split out.

claims.heading: الْكَلَامُ
claims.note: Three concepts: الكلام itself, then the فعلية/اسمية split. Two of the four textbook exercises were dropped — see omitted_content.yaml.

claims.heading: الْمَبْنِيُّ وَالْمُعْرَبُ
claims.note: Kept on its own rather than merged with أنواع البناء; that section adds four more concepts and would push the lesson past five.

claims.heading: أَنْوَاعُ الْبِنَاءِ
claims.note: Four concepts, one per state. The book gives only three examples each for الضم/الفتح/الكسر — that is the whole closed class, not a shortfall.

claims.heading: أَصْنَافُ الْمَبْنِيَّاتِ
claims.note: Split across lessons 8 and 9 at the book's own seam: whole word-types (حروف, أفعال) in 8, the closed list of nouns in 9. One 723-word section would have been six concepts. The حرف letter-count taxonomy and the pronoun conjugation tables were cut — see omitted_content.yaml.

claims.heading: أَصْنَافُ الْمَبْنِيَّاتِ
claims.note: Second half of the split; see the lesson 8 claim.
